adjudication.rationale: When no TopicEmbed exists, `EmbedController#best` enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` and renders `embed/loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:14-18). The loading template unconditionally reloads the iframe every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:6-9) and there is no terminal/error state. If retrieval never produces a `TopicEmbed` (e.g., `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` returns early when `embed_by_username` user is blank, or remote fetch/parse fails), the iframe will stay in an infinite reload loop with no user feedback. The mention of `PollFeed` being `retry: false` is ancillary, but the “no failure path → infinite loading” behavior is directly supported by the diff.
